title: SemanticEnergyProbe Tier 0f — Boltzmann Pairwise Semantic Energy (arXiv 2508.14496)
auc_note: AUC=1.0 on 50 synthetic pairs (25 coherent, 25 hallucinated-with-rogue-sentence) using TF bag-of-words + random projection embeddings. Perfect discrimination because synthetic rogue sentences have zero vocabulary overlap with coherent sentences.
design_notes: Uses TF (term frequency, not TF-IDF) for intra-response sentence embeddings. TF-IDF penalises shared words via IDF, but within a single response, shared words indicate topical coherence and should contribute positively to similarity.
Random projection (Johnson-Lindenstrauss) reduces high-dimensional TF sparse vectors to dense 64-dim embeddings while approximately preserving pairwise distances. Seed=42 for deterministic results.
Pairwise Gaussian kernel: k_ij = exp(-||e_i-e_j||^2 / sigma^2). Energy = -mean(k_ij) over all i!=j pairs. Negative because coherent sentences are close → high kernel → more negative energy.

Threshold -0.5 chosen so coherent responses (energy ~ -0.85 for 4 repetitive sentences) are clearly below and responses with fully orthogonal rogue sentences (energy ~ -0.11 for 2 sentences) are clearly above.
Advisory pattern mirrors Tier 0e HalluField: is_unstable=True records in certificate but does NOT short-circuit downstream tiers.
